title: Read API: the graph nodes, the possible links and the last paths
goal: A dashboard endpoint returns nodes by column, links between possible followers, and recent decisions
acceptance: Test first on the endpoint shape; nodes come from config (roles, routes, models), links from what each column may reach (Casper only to local)
Auth like the other dashboard endpoints; a bounded number of recent sorties
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
